description: N58 piano lines by elaboration (docs/learned_workflow.md section 6f), driven by the N58 'Piano (D)' 8-bar tables (A aeolian over Am7). Each track starts from one held pitch, drawn per track from the input's pitches at the final note's position, plus a last note of the same pitch on beat 1 of bar 8, held 4 beats, whose rhythm is frozen but whose pitch evolves; each cycle adds 4 edits (split, join, new note, re-pitch, note to rest). Mirrored: 20 cycles (160 bars) forward, one held note -> busy, then the same cycles reversed, so the tracks start and end on a chord. 16 tracks x 320 bars. Mirror variant of N58_elaborate_piano_Aaeolian_8bar_4edits (Ken, 2026-11-26).
